Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

BULKHEAD ELBOW BODY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 

PART I MADE FROM FORCINGS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for bulkhead elbow body 
for use in oil-hydraulic sytems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material — Steel conforming to Class 1A of IS : 1875-1978 ' Specification for carbon steel billets, 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings {fourth revision)' or any other steel as agreed to between 
the user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — The bulkhead elbow bodies shall be phosphated to Class A2 of IS; 
3618-1966 'Phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion 1 , unless 
otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5-1 These bulkhead elbow bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with IS : 9770-1981 
1 Specification for bulkhead elbow coupling assembly for oil-hydraulic systems \ 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS: 8805 (Part I )-1978 
' General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems: Part I General '. 

6. Designation — A bulkhead elbow body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 6 mm and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Bulkhead Elbow Body L6 IS : 9757 ( Part I ) 



CO 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers bulkhead elbow bodies made from forgings only. The bulkhead 
elbow bodies made from bar stock are covered in IS : 9757 ( Part II ) 'Specification for bulkhead 
elbow bodies for oil-hydraulic couplings; Part II Made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 
standards: 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes: 
Part I 1972 Heavy series ( metric), and 
Part III 1974 Light series (metric). British Standards Institution (BSI). 

DIN 3911:1965 Non-soldered taper-bush type pipe unions; elbow bulkhead lead-in fittings 
for use with union nut. Deutsches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ). 



Adopted 12 March 1981
